description: Create a token set (access token + refresh token) for token-based authentication. Requires an active token generator.

accessTokenHours.description: Access token validity in hours (1-17520, default 72); 'UL' for unlimited

keyTag.description: Key tag - unique identifier derived from key name

refreshTokenHours.description: Refresh token validity in hours (1-17520, default 2160); 'UL' for unlimited

name: ncloud_kms_create_token_set
